features.title: Control feedback and session-data sharing
features.summary: Independently control answer feedback, session feedback capture, OpenTelemetry session-log export, and official DeepSeek API session-log upload; keep local log downloads separate. The answer-feedback UI requires the sessionFeedback Host Remote.
reach: fill combobox "Search the command palette" "Settings: Feedback"
failureModes: Answer feedback UI cannot start without the sessionFeedback Remote; the UI requires session feedback capture first.
The master action changes only four feedback/upload rows and never changes session-log download.
Malformed profile patches are rejected without overwriting user-owned content.

verification.testName: appends only marked row-state overrides and preserves unrelated YAML
enforces the feedback Remote dependency without changing the patch on rejection
